name: journal-masthead
description: Top-of-paper surface for a /working-papers JOURNAL article: an engine-generated forward-looking/no-investment-advice notice blockquote, followed by a one-line meta-line stating imprint, version, and license. Never hand-authored in the article's own body source — both are assembled from frontmatter at render time, same principle already established for this corpus's render contract.

variants.name: default
variants.description: Single-notice, single-meta-line masthead. The notice text is not hardcoded here — it is composed per-site by brand, resolved via tokens/linguistic/register-journal.yaml's forward_looking_notice_by_brand block: PointSav-brand sites (home.pointsav.com, software.pointsav.com, design.pointsav.com) use factory-release-engineering/tokens/legal-tokens-pointsav.yaml's disclaimers.no_investment_advice text — PointSav-brand properties structurally carry no investment/forward-looking-statement disclaimer, per that file's own explicit note. Woodfine-brand sites (home.woodfinegroup.com, bim.woodfinegroup.com, gis.woodfinegroup.com) use factory-release-engineering/tokens/legal-tokens-woodfine.yaml's disclaimers.forward_looking.short — the real securities-law forward-looking-information notice, matching that file's own footer.investment template tier. Resolved 2026-09-23 against both brands' already-vetted disclaimer text directly, not invented for this component.

aria:
blockquote is native semantic HTML — no additional ARIA role needed. The meta-line is a plain

, not a heading — it must not be picked up by heading-based navigation (e.g. wiki-toc-sidebar) as a section.
